I was confused with some of the scenarios where it stated they had no interest in sharing food then the action was to share their food.

In the first scenario when we don't yet know what actions they took, I was judging their relationships based on what the scenario was. Like one of the scenarios had 2 people preparing dip together for a party. To me that says that they're more than acquaintances, because that's something good friends do together and possibly an intimate couple. A lot of the situations seemed like dates to me, so I assumed it was intimate, but it could have been a first date, so the level of intimacy was higher than the middle, but not all the way to the right. I wanted to explain my reasoning for my answers in case you had any questions about how I came to my conclusions. This was a lot of fun! Thank you for the opportunity and best of luck with your research.
